sql: WITH scope AS(SELECT ?::text company_id,?::bigint now_ms) SELECT 'item' kind,i.id,to_jsonb(i)::text fact FROM legal_items i,scope WHERE i.company_id=scope.company_id AND i.state NOT IN ('archived','closed','completed','expired','terminated','cancelled','rejected') UNION ALL SELECT 'legal_case_events' kind,f.id,to_jsonb(f)::text fact FROM legal_case_events f LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=f.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR f.state NOT IN ('completed','closed','cancelled','acknowledged','waived','accepted','billed') AND NOT(f.category='custody' AND f.state='received')) UNION ALL SELECT 'legal_compliance_actions' kind,f.id,to_jsonb(f)::text fact FROM legal_compliance_actions f LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=f.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR f.state NOT IN ('completed','closed','cancelled','acknowledged','waived','accepted','billed') AND NOT(f.category='custody' AND f.state='received')) UNION ALL SELECT 'legal_privacy_cases' kind,f.id,to_jsonb(f)::text fact FROM legal_privacy_cases f LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=f.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR f.state NOT IN ('completed','closed','cancelled','acknowledged','waived','accepted','billed') AND NOT(f.category='custody' AND f.state='received')) UNION ALL SELECT 'legal_corporate_actions' kind,f.id,to_jsonb(f)::text fact FROM legal_corporate_actions f LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=f.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR f.state NOT IN ('completed','closed','cancelled','acknowledged','waived','accepted','billed') AND NOT(f.category='custody' AND f.state='received')) UNION ALL SELECT 'legal_ip_actions' kind,f.id,to_jsonb(f)::text fact FROM legal_ip_actions f LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=f.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR f.state NOT IN ('completed','closed','cancelled','acknowledged','waived','accepted','billed') AND NOT(f.category='custody' AND f.state='received')) UNION ALL SELECT 'legal_counsel_entries' kind,f.id,to_jsonb(f)::text fact FROM legal_counsel_entries f LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=f.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR f.state NOT IN ('completed','closed','cancelled','acknowledged','waived','accepted','billed') AND NOT(f.category='custody' AND f.state='received')) UNION ALL SELECT 'legal_obligation_schedule' kind,f.id,to_jsonb(f)::text fact FROM legal_obligation_schedule f LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=f.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR f.state NOT IN ('completed','closed','cancelled','acknowledged','waived','accepted','billed') AND NOT(f.category='custody' AND f.state='received')) UNION ALL SELECT 'legal_custody_events' kind,f.id,to_jsonb(f)::text fact FROM legal_custody_events f LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=f.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR f.state NOT IN ('completed','closed','cancelled','acknowledged','waived','accepted','billed') AND NOT(f.category='custody' AND f.state='received')) UNION ALL SELECT 'legal_policy_acknowledgements' kind,f.id,to_jsonb(f)::text fact FROM legal_policy_acknowledgements f LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=f.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR f.state NOT IN ('completed','closed','cancelled','acknowledged','waived','accepted','billed') AND NOT(f.category='custody' AND f.state='received')) UNION ALL SELECT 'legal_intake_questions' kind,f.id,to_jsonb(f)::text fact FROM legal_intake_questions f LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=f.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR f.state NOT IN ('completed','closed','cancelled','acknowledged','waived','accepted','billed') AND NOT(f.category='custody' AND f.state='received')) UNION ALL SELECT 'hold',h.id,to_jsonb(h)::text FROM legal_holds h LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=h.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND h.state<>'released' UNION ALL SELECT 'share',s.id,to_jsonb(s)::text FROM legal_shares s LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=s.item_id LEFT JOIN legal_documents d ON d.id=s.document_id AND d.item_id=s.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR d.id IS NULL OR s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at>scope.now_ms) UNION ALL SELECT 'executed-review',e.id,to_jsonb(e)::text FROM legal_executed_copies e LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=e.item_id LEFT JOIN legal_documents d ON d.id=e.document_id AND d.item_id=e.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR d.id IS NULL OR e.state<>'confirmed') UNION ALL SELECT 'approval',r.item_id,to_jsonb(r)::text FROM legal_approval_routes r LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=r.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR i.state IN ('review','approval','signing')) UNION ALL SELECT 'ai-job',j.id,to_jsonb(j)::text FROM legal_ai_proposals j LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=j.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR j.state IN ('queued','running','proposed')) UNION ALL SELECT 'processing-job',j.id,to_jsonb(j)::text FROM legal_processing_jobs j LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=j.item_id,scope WHERE (j.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.company_id=scope.company_id) AND (i.id IS NULL OR i.company_id<>j.company_id OR j.state IN ('queued','running')) UNION ALL SELECT 'invitation-job',j.id,to_jsonb(j)::text FROM legal_invitation_jobs j LEFT JOIN legal_shares s ON s.id=j.share_id LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=s.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR j.state IN ('queued','running')) UNION ALL SELECT 'destruction',d.id,to_jsonb(d)::text FROM legal_destructions d LEFT JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=d.item_id,scope WHERE (i.company_id=scope.company_id OR i.id IS NULL) AND (i.id IS NULL OR d.state NOT IN ('completed','cancelled','rejected')) UNION ALL SELECT 'intake-form',f.id,to_jsonb(f)::text FROM legal_intake_forms f,scope WHERE f.company_id=scope.company_id AND f.state='draft' UNION ALL SELECT 'retention-policy',p.id,to_jsonb(p)::text FROM legal_retention_policies p,scope WHERE p.company_id=scope.company_id AND p.state='draft' ORDER BY kind,id,fact
